0022600221.text: The Grizzlies, 7-3 and fifth in the West, host the Denver Nuggets, 5-3 and ninth in the West, in Memphis's 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Memphis on a one-game winning streak and Denver on a two-game run. Memphis is 5-0 on the road but 2-3 at home, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Grizzlies lost 1-3 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026. Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness) are out for Memphis, Isaiah Stewart (knee, bruise) and Quinten Post (head) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee, sprain).
